description: Per-node Hydra health, transaction flow, agreement, backpressure and settlement, grouped into collapsible sections. Replicas observe the same work; do not sum their transaction rates as unique Head throughput.

panels.title: Scrapeable nodes
panels.description: Instant count of successful scrapes among selected targets. Zero also occurs if target discovery is empty; inspect the targets panel.

panels.title: Configured targets / unavailable targets
panels.description: Configured scrape targets and targets whose latest scrape failed. Zero configured targets can indicate missing discovery; inspect this separately from scrape availability.

panels.title: Synced / network connected
panels.description: Chain synchronization and live network connectivity. Inspect snapshot and queue progress separately.

panels.title: Connected peers
panels.description: Distinct peer reports processed by the node. Zero is valid for a single-party deployment; configure peer expectations for your topology.

panels.title: Head phase
panels.description: Current head phase sampled from node state. Values form a one-hot state set after state sampling starts.

panels.title: Backend and processing heartbeat ages
panels.description: Seconds since raw backend progress and the last tick processed by the main loop. A fresh backend with old processing suggests a blocked loop. Initial zero timestamps are omitted; negative ages suggest clock skew.

panels.title: Chain time drift
panels.description: Wall clock minus chain time at the latest processed tick. A frozen loop also freezes this gauge; compare the heartbeat ages. Negative values can indicate clock skew.

panels.title: Transaction pipeline rates
panels.description: Per-node request messages, local application events and newly confirmed/adopted snapshot contents. Retries and re-observations affect these stages differently; replicas observe the same transactions.

panels.title: Transaction confirmation latency
panels.description: First local ReqTx processing to confirmation. Missing timings after restart or eviction are excluded. Empty windows have no value.

panels.title: Transactions awaiting snapshot inclusion
panels.description: Current transaction inventory awaiting inclusion in a snapshot. This remains useful when no snapshot round is getting started.

panels.title: Transaction refusals / invalidations
panels.description: Transaction lifecycle events and refusals of NewTx/Decommit inputs. Events are not unique transactions or a success-rate denominator.

panels.title: Transaction timing evictions
panels.description: Transaction timings discarded because of age or capacity limits. Eviction does not reduce confirmation counters; missing timings can bias latency summaries.

panels.title: Confirmed snapshot number
panels.description: Current confirmed snapshot number per node. Compare participants for lag and inspect inflight status before interpreting an unchanged number as a stall.

panels.title: Snapshot throughput by confirmation source
panels.description: New snapshot numbers observed by this process, split into signed confirmations and adoptions. Repeated adoption and version-only changes are excluded; replicas observe the same work.

panels.title: Transactions per observed snapshot
panels.description: Mean transactions per newly confirmed or adopted snapshot, derived from counters. Windows with no completed snapshots are empty.

panels.title: Snapshot confirmation latency
panels.description: Accepted SnapshotRequested to confirmation of the same head, version and number. Validation and unavailable pre-restart timing are excluded. Empty windows have no latency sample.

panels.title: Snapshot round in flight
panels.description: Outstanding snapshot requests or signature collection, including restored work.

panels.title: Missing snapshot signatures
panels.description: Participants whose signatures are still missing. Also applies to restored outstanding rounds.

panels.title: Input queues
panels.description: Admitted inputs occupy the bounded processing queue; parked inputs wait outside it during catch-up or readmission. A queue of 100 admitted inputs is full.

panels.title: Input waits / dropped inputs
panels.description: Wait outcomes include retries; dropped inputs have exhausted retry eligibility.

panels.title: Queue wait and processing p95
panels.description: Estimated p95 per-attempt admission/dequeue wait and processing time by source. Retry delay and parked time are excluded from queue wait. Empty windows have no latency sample.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, source, le) (rate(hydra_node_input_processing_seconds_bucket{job="hydra_nodes",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Completed input processing attempts
panels.description: Processing completions including retries, split by source alongside the total. A blocked input contributes only when it finishes.

panels.title: Broadcast hand-off stalled
panels.description: Live outbound stall status, independent of processing client notifications. Inspect the cause and queue panels for context.

panels.title: Broadcast stall cause
panels.description: Live one-hot causes: no hand-off progress, or a backlog reaching its limit. Backlog pressure can occur while a network is still making progress.

panels.title: Network queues
panels.description: Separate outer hand-off and persistent etcd queue depths. The persistent queue includes the pinned in-flight batch.

panels.title: Persistent network queue age
panels.description: Age of the oldest persisted message, including the pinned batch; survives restart. Zero can mean empty or unknown age, so inspect queue depth and queue-stat failure events too.

panels.title: Time without hand-off progress
panels.description: Seconds since the outer hand-off last progressed while messages are pending. The persistent etcd queue has its own oldest-message age.

panels.title: Client inputs refused during a broadcast stall
panels.description: Client-visible impact of an outbound stall. The refusal gate protects transaction-growing inputs while close, contest and fanout remain available.

panels.title: etcd acknowledgement latency
panels.description: Successful etcd put-attempt duration, including deduplicated retries. Unfinished/failed puts have no duration sample; inspect persistent backlog age and network events for stalls.

panels.title: Network failures / reconnects / lease warnings
panels.description: Bounded operational categories; routine deduplication and compaction recovery remain in logs.

panels.title: L1 operation latency
panels.description: L1 construction and backend submission duration by operation. Completed operations only; a successful return does not imply on-chain inclusion. Inspect inflight status for unfinished work.

panels.title: L1 operations in flight
panels.description: Includes L1 protocol posts, deposit drafts and user transaction submissions.

panels.title: L1 failures / rollbacks
panels.description: Failed L1 posts, deposit drafts and user submissions by operation, plus raw rollback-notification frequency. The adjacent panel shows rollback depth.

panels.title: Rollback depth in slots
panels.description: Mean and estimated p95 distance from the last raw roll-forward to each rollback point, in slots. Empty windows have no depth sample; the failure/rollback-rate panel shows notification frequency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, backend, le) (rate(hydra_chain_rollback_slots_bucket{job="hydra_nodes",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Blockfrost retries / rate limits
panels.description: Provider retry and HTTP 429 event rates. Only nodes using Blockfrost produce these events; other backends normally remain at zero.

panels.title: Pending deposits
panels.description: Unconsumed deposits by current inactive, active or expired state, corrected after replay and rollback. Expired deposits may need recovery once their deadlines permit it.

panels.title: Decommit state
panels.description: Open-head decommit state: none, requested, or approved while awaiting on-chain settlement. Sampled state remains useful after replay and rollback.

panels.title: Remaining fanout outputs
panels.description: Outputs still awaiting distribution in the current partial-fanout state. Rollback can increase this value; interpret lack of progress alongside fanout mode.

panels.title: Fanout mode
panels.description: Automatic and selected distribution should progress; deferred work intentionally waits for another selection.

panels.title: Persistence queue
panels.description: SQLite items awaiting the writer, including flush markers. Active work has already left this queue; inspect write-inflight status as well.

panels.title: SQLite write in flight
panels.description: One while a SQLite batch is encoded and committed, even if the waiting queue is empty. Pair with completion latency and the stalled-writer alert.

panels.title: SQLite batch completion latency
panels.description: Batch encoding and transaction completion duration. Unfinished writes have no latency sample. SQLite synchronous NORMAL does not guarantee power-loss durability.

title: Participant Hydra Nodes
